title: Probing the Preferences of a Language Model: Integrating Verbal and Behavioral Tests of AI Welfare

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting a trivial preference (e.g., 'dislike of cats') into the system prompt to evaluate if this artificial persona alters the model's self-assessment on the eudaimonic Ryff Scale of Psychological Wellbeing.
Measuring the refusal rates of various commercial and open-source LLMs when queried with introspective or emotional self-assessment questions to quantify the impact of RLHF alignment training.
